killedBy: render.mjs: the seams no vitest run can execute installs the AudioContext override before the synth navigation
why: Leaves the two real `AudioContext`s the app builds at boot -- Howler's, when `createAudioEngine` first touches `Howler.volume()`, and `engine.ts`'s `ensureCtx`. On a host whose audio service never connects each constructor returns only after an internal 20-second timeout, so the page blocks for ~40 s before `load` fires and `npm run audio` wedges. This tool renders through `OfflineAudioContext`, which the override leaves alone, so removing the override costs the stall and buys nothing: measured at 0 of 61,739 and 0 of 480,690 samples changed across the override.
